description: The tax invoice for one order as a PDF attached to the result, once the order is invoiced (paid, or on a Team's account once approved). Otherwise it says plainly that there is no invoice yet. The order page link has Download invoice too. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

order.description: The order number (or the order id from its link).

name: get_invoice
title: Get an order's invoice
